lead_raw_text:
The structure of La8Ag4Pd4 (reduced formula La2AgPd) crystallizes in the cubic space group Fm-3m (No. 225), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows each Ag and Pd center has eight La neighbors, while each La center has four Ag and four Pd neighbors, all at 3.2277 Å, forming body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among La 8-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between Ag and Pd 8-vertex polyhedra.
